purpose: Teach: 倭/弌/丙/鉉/辺野古/住専/フジサンケイビジネスアイ/日本経済新聞社
target_vocab: フジサンケイビジネスアイ

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、倭国時代の医療史を医療チームで研究します
lines.en: Ren, we're going to research the medical history of the Wa period as a team.
lines.style: Clear, direct. Measured pace. Clinical but not cold — the tone of a senior doctor laying out a project plan. Slight pause after his name, allowing space for acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、旧字「弌」、つまり一を含む医薬古書を医療チームで保管します
lines.en: Ren, we'll be archiving classical medical texts that contain the old character for 'one' — we're making that a team priority.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact. Enunciate the detail with precision. Warm undertone — this is important work, and she's including him in it. No condescension.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医療文書の丙、つまり丙号級の管理を医療チームで徹底します
lines.en: Ren, managing third-grade classification documents — we're going to standardize that across the team.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. The slight emphasis on 'standardize' shows this is non-negotiable. Still her clinical composure — this is a necessary order, delivered with respect.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、鉉、つまり鉉の鼎の薬学的記録を医療チームで研究します
lines.en: Ren, the pharmacological records related to the ancient tripod vessel — the team is going to research that together.
lines.style: Slightly slower pace on the historical reference. Curious but grounded. She's signaling this is worthwhile work, and she trusts him to see why. Steady eye-contact level.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、辺野古地区の医療提供を医療チームで継続します
lines.en: Ren, we're continuing medical services in the Henoko district — that remains a team commitment.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. The opening name carries weight — she's reminding him why this matters. Steady, unflinching. No apology in her voice.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、住専、つまり住宅金融問題の社会医学的影響を医療チームで研究します
lines.en: Ren, we're examining the social medicine implications of the housing finance crisis — we'll be looking at this as a team.
lines.style: Clear, methodical. The breadth of the project lands without fanfare. She's treating him as someone who can hold the complexity. Composed, intellectually generous.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、フジサンケイビジネスアイの医療記事を医療チームで参照します
lines.en: Ren, we'll be referencing the medical coverage from Fuji Sankei Business i across the team.
lines.style: Brief, efficient. The tone of moving through agenda items. Professional distance, but underlying respect — she's trusting him with the task.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、日本経済新聞社の医療経済記事を医療チームで参照します
lines.en: Ren, we're using the medical economics articles from the Nikkei for our team reference materials.
lines.style: Quieter landing. Closing tone — this is the last point. Slight softness on his name this time. A full breath of composure at the end.
